visual.general_description: Four 3D rendered antenatal ultrasound views (A to D) of a fetus from the first pregnancy in warm gold-brown shading on a dark background.
visual.detailed_description: A 2 by 2 arrangement of rendered views, each marked with a white panel letter box at the upper left. Panel A and panel D carry on-screen device labels reading "UPPER LIMBS" and "LOWER LIMBS". The caption attributes bilateral clenched fists (A), flexion at the shoulders and elbows (B), flexion at hip with hyperextension at the knees (C) and club feet (D) to the fetus.

Small hand or finger-like structures are visible near the face; surrounding grey-white tissue forms the lower right side of the frame. Fine joint detail is limited at this rendering.

panels.detailed_description: Web-page capture showing the text "Features:" with two linked entries reading "THO complex subunit 2 isoform X2" and "THO complex subunit 2 isoform X1". Two alignment blocks follow: the first lists "Query" 1 to 60 against "Sbjct" 123628041 to 123627982 with matched-bar lines, and the second lists "Query" 61 to 116 against "Sbjct" 123627981 to 123627922. Beneath the nucleotide lines are many rows labelled "CDS: THO complex subu..." and "CDS: Putative 1" to "Putative 11" with single-letter amino-acid rows. A red arrow points to a short run of dashes in the query line of the second block, where the subject line carries four bases in the same position; the amino-acid rows below show a magenta S in the subject translations at this site.
